---
title: "`r params$report_title`"
author: "`r params$author`"
date: "`r if (isTRUE(params$include_date)) format(Sys.Date()) else ''`"
output: html_document
params:
  report_title: "MERIDIAN Analysis Report"
  author: ""
  institution: ""
  notes: ""
  include_date: true
  sections: !r character()
  tables: !r list()
  plots: !r list()
  methods_text: ""
  meta: !r list()
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  dpi = 300, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6, fig.align = "center")
if (capabilities("cairo")) knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "png", dev.args = list(type = "cairo"))
escape <- function(x) as.character(htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x)))
```

```{r context, results='asis'}
if (nzchar(params$institution)) cat("<p><strong>Institution:</strong> ", escape(params$institution), "</p>\n")
if (nzchar(params$notes)) cat("<p><strong>Notes:</strong> ", escape(params$notes), "</p>\n")
if ("Data Description" %in% params$sections && length(params$meta)) {
  cat("## Dataset\n\n")
  meta <- data.frame(Field = names(params$meta), Value = vapply(params$meta, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ", "), character(1)))
  cat(knitr::kable(meta, format = "html", escape = TRUE, row.names = FALSE), "\n\n")
}
```

```{r selected-tables, results='asis'}
if (length(params$tables)) cat("## Selected tables\n\n")
for (i in seq_along(params$tables)) {
  label <- names(params$tables)[i]
  cat("<h3>", escape(label), "</h3>\n")
  display <- as.data.frame(params$tables[[i]])
  for (column in grep("^p[_.]?value$|^pval", names(display), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)) {
    if (is.numeric(display[[column]])) display[[column]] <- ifelse(is.na(display[[column]]), "", formatC(display[[column]], format = "e", digits = 3))
  }
  cat(knitr::kable(display, format = "html", escape = TRUE, digits = 5, row.names = FALSE), "\n\n")
}
```

```{r selected-figures, results='asis'}
if (length(params$plots)) cat("## Selected figures\n\n")
for (i in seq_along(params$plots)) {
  cat("<h3>", escape(names(params$plots)[i]), "</h3>\n")
  print(params$plots[[i]])
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r methods, results='asis'}
if ("Methods Description" %in% params$sections && nzchar(params$methods_text)) {
  cat("## Methods and provenance\n\n<p>", escape(params$methods_text), "</p>\n")
}
```
